body.space: a finite list of affine maps on \(\Delta(\mathcal J)\)
body.def: \(\mathscr L_0\) is the complete finite rational list \(\psi(p)=\alpha_{\psi}^{\prime}p+\beta_{\psi}\) obtained from every branch inequality for the minimum, positive-part, capacity, and generalized-inverse operations, every primal and dual feasibility or optimality inequality for the separate endpoint programs over \(\Xi(p)\), and every affine semantic assertion inequality. The list is evaluated at \(p_0\) before localizing; no expression \(p_0+Bu\) is treated as a probability law.
